items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And it says on the back, the XANA director, Tuva Gerard Levison, is that his name? Who? [INTERVIEWEE] Levy. Oh, Levy? Leviton. Leviton, that's right.

ctx.x: No, I believe we took two fiddles instead of the trombone. We took an extra fiddle. Yeah.
And it says on the back, the XANA director, Tuva Gerard Levison, is that his name? Who?
Levy. Oh, Levy? Leviton. Leviton, that's right.
